formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --background: 230 30% 10%;
  --foreground: 0 0% 100%;
  --card: 230 30% 14%;
  --card-foreground: 0 0% 100%;
  --popover: 230 30% 14%;
  --popover-foreground: 0 0% 100%;
  --muted: 230 20% 22%;
  --muted-foreground: 0 0% 85%;
  --accent: 230 20% 26%;
  --accent-foreground: 0 0% 100%;
  --border: 230 20% 40%;
  --input: 230 20% 50%;
  --ring: 0 0% 100%;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background-color: #14162e;
}
.login-background::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(8, 10, 28, 0.25) 0%, rgba(8, 10, 28, 0.5) 100%);
}
.login-topbar,
.login-content,
#footer {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 430px;
}
.login-panel {
  border-radius: 24px;
}
.login-topbar button {
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-panel {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.28);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
  backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(150%);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(150%);
}
.signin-methods > div {
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92) !important;
  color: #14162e;
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 46px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio'])::placeholder {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: #ffffff;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
}
.login-password button {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-form a {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 48px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  background: {{accentColor}};
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -10px {{accentColor}};
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  filter: brightness(1.1);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link,
.login-form .login-forget-password label {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}
#footer {
  background: rgba(10, 12, 30, 0.45);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
